source_summary: A sparse Chinese ink landscape with calligraphy and seals in the upper field excluded. Reusable motifs are drawn from the lower landscape: misty distant mountains at left, wooded ridges and cliffs, open water/mist space, and foreground rocky banks with wintery shrubs and trees.

motifs.name: misty_left_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the soft dark triangular distant peak on the far lower-left horizon, including the faint adjacent hill silhouettes fading into mist.
must_preserve: soft gray ink wash forming the peak
subtle tonal gradation from dark summit to pale base

motifs.name: wooded_upper_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the tree-covered ridge across the upper part of the left mountain mass, with clustered dark conifer-like marks and sloping terrain beneath.
must_preserve: broken dry-brush texture within the woods

motifs.name: sheer_right_cliff_face
motifs.description: Isolate the pale vertical cliff face to the right of the wooded ridge, including angular contour lines and the narrow dark base where it meets mist.
must_preserve: dark soft base accents fading into mist

motifs.name: lower_left_forested_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the descending lower-left mountain slope with sparse dark trees, exposed pale rock contours, and tapering lines leading downward.

motifs.name: central_lake_mist_field
motifs.description: Isolate the broad open middle field of water or mist between the mountains and foreground trees, preserving only the faint horizontal wash bands and atmospheric emptiness.
must_preserve: uninterrupted mist edges without calligraphy or seals

motifs.name: central_willow_shrub_mass
motifs.description: Isolate the sprawling central foreground thicket of low willow-like shrubs, with interlaced bare branches rising from dark ink clumps.
must_preserve: dark root and trunk ink clumps
small pale gaps between crossing branches

motifs.name: right_winter_tree_reeds
motifs.description: Isolate the right foreground cluster of leafless trees and reed-like grasses, including the taller branched forms and dense dark bases.
must_preserve: dark ink reed clusters at the base

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the bottom foreground shoreline and rock bank beneath the shrubs, with pale sloping rock slabs, dark accent strokes, and a winding bank edge.

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
